facility.name: Powersports Gymnastics INC.
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,After School Care,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 10810 STATE HWY 30, COLLEGE STATION, TX, 77845

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A pair of underwear with feces was observed to be in one of the childrens bathroom sink. This was corrected at inspection when the director removed the underwear and sanitized the sink. A toilet in one of the childrens bathroom was observed to have feces left in and covering the toilet. This was corrected at inspection when the director sanitized and flushed the toilet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: 2 first aid kits observed to have all items expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There were plants growing on the playground that were observed to have thorns. This was corrected at inspection when a caregiver removed the plants.  A part of a slide was observed to be cracked. This was corrected at inspection when a caregiver put duct tape over the crack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: One caregiver did not have child maltreatment training completed during the review training period.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985): One caregiver did not have a notorized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle: During a DFPS investigation, it was found the driver did not utilize the electronic child alarm system and conduct a physical walk-through of the vehicle after children in care were transported to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: During a DFPS Investigation it was found a child in care was left in the transportation van for approximately 2 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: The director was missing 6 hours of annual training and a caregiver was missing 6 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There was an exposed metal on the playground equipment that could lead to injury.    There was a plant accessible to children on the playground coming from the ground that has thrones on it.    On the play ground set there was a mud dauber nest on the roof.    In the men's bathroom there is a hole in the big stall that can injury a child.    In the 2-year-old classroom the plastic trim is exposed and  can cause a tripping hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Notification of Reduction of Toilets/Sinks: There were two toilets out of used at the operation. There were two sinks with broken handles that cannot be used until fixed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Reduction of Toilets/Sinks (26 TAC §746.301(3))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Four out of ten caregiver files reviewed did not have pediatric first aid training,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Six out of ten caregiver files reviewed did not have pediatric CPR training that consists of a curriculum that includes use of a CPR manikin and both written and hands-on skill-based instruction, practice, and testing
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Three out of ten caregiver files did not have the 24 hours of annual training completed. The caregivers were missing training in abuse and neglect, hazardous materials, building and physical premises safety, and food allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregivers failed to demonstrate good judgement by routinely allowing a group of children to sit in a dark corner of the gym, separate from the main group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Janitorial duties: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that caregivers conduct janitorial duties while supervising children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Janitorial duties (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(C))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that screen time was used during rest times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that caregivers failed to supervise children when children participated in inappropriate behaviors and games.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: The operation did not report suspected abuse or neglect to the Department of Family Protective Services.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §746.1201(5))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that the gymnasium lighting was too dark during rest time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Upon review of caregiver training files, 2 training files were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During an unannounced follow up inspection there was a caregiver present and caring for children without an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: While doing an unannounced investigation inspection there was a caregiver presented and caring for children on a field trip. This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver was sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an investigation it was found that caregivers were not properly supervising a child who was injured while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an investigation it was found caregivers were not actively supervising children by not having visual or auditory awareness of a child who swallowed a quarter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation did not display good judgement when they gave a child a cupcake while a quarter was lodged in the child's throat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During an investigation it was found a caregiver was on a personal device when a child swallowed a quarter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization: During the investigation it was found parents were not notified of an incident requiring medical attention of their child, until approximately 45 minutes to an hour after the incident occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation did not report an incident where a child sought medical treatment from an injury sustained at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Observed multiple classrooms and area's used by the children with chemicals in the reach of the children. There was sunscreen, lysol wipes and micro ban in the reach of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The operation has added new vehicles and they are not equipped with a child safety alarm system. I discussed this with the owner of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Observed trash on the playground and a fence that had an opening on the toddler playground which poses an entrapment risk to children. I spoke to the owner about these concerns.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Observed multiple medications at the operation that were expired. This was discussed with the owner of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)
